svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 140 x 140 mm from 8 mm aluminium plate; square

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the edges and round the corners to about 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Anchor holes: four 11 mm holes on a 100 mm square (20 mm in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from each edge), for M10 wall anchors.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flange holes: four 9 mm holes on an 80 mm circle, at 45 degrees

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to the edges; countersink them on the wall side for M8

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countersunk screws, so the heads sit flush against the wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check the flange you bought: its hole circle sets these four holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the flange bolts to the outer face with four M8 countersunk

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screws and nyloc nuts; the plate goes on the gable wall with four

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: anchors, its centre 43 mm to the side of the mast's line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the flange sits flat and no screw head stands proud at the back.
